newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NORDBANKEN SAYS NOT IN TALKS WITH ABN.
newsitem.headline: NORDBANKEN SAYS NOT IN TALKS WITH ABN.

text.p: No merger talks are going on between Swedish Nordbanken and S-E-Banken or Dutch ABN AMRO , Nordbanken's chairman Jacob Palmstierna said on Tuesday.
"There are no talks whatsoever going on between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken," Palmstierna told Reuters.
When asked if this also holds true regarding ABN AMRO he said: "Yes...that will be the same answer."
State-controlled Nordbanken and S-E-Banken announced early in February that merger talks had ended without conclusion.

But analysts expected talks to resume with pressure mounting on the two banks amid a restructuring of Sweden's banking and finance sector. Swedbank and Foreningsbanken plan to merge and Handelsbanken has bought mortgage lender Stadshypotek .
Palmstierna did not want to comment on S-E-Banken's Tuesday announcement that its chief executive Bjorn Svedberg is leaving the bank.
"I can only state that it's an established custom in the business community that chief executives resign at the age of 60 and that is Svedberg's age," Palmstierna said.
